title: Light Filipino Lamb Shanks Lumpia
description: Buttery, light, and festive Filipino dish featuring lamb shanks, ideal for diabetic-friendly meals. Each serving is crunchy on the outside and tender on the inside.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use low-sodium salt for diabetic-friendly option

instructions: Dust lamb shanks with all-purpose flour, shaking off excess.
In a large bowl, mix together paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Dip floured lamb shanks in beaten eggs, coating evenly.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add lamb shanks to the skillet and sear until browned on all sides.
Transfer lamb shanks to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add a small amount of oil to coat the bottom.
Dust lumpia wrappers with all-purpose flour, shaking off excess.
Place a lamb shank in the center of a lumpia wrapper, leaving a 1-inch border around it.
Brush edges of the wrapper with egg wash.
Fold the bottom half of the wrapper over the lamb shank, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with remaining lamb shanks and wrappers.
Fry lumpia in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain lumpia on paper towels and serve hot.
